msg_telemetry:
Hi! 👋

To help me improve BadWords, do you agree to send a one-time, 100% anonymous ping after installation / update?

Only the app version and OS type (e.g., Windows) are sent. Audio files, scripts, or personal data are NEVER collected.

Geolocation (country/city) is optional — uncheck the box below to disable it.

You can change these preferences anytime in Settings → Telemetry.

tt_chunk_max_words:
Determines the maximum number of words possible
in a single line of the transcript.
tt_chunk_lookahead:
Determines how far ahead the algorithm looks for words
with punctuation OVER the limit from the first parameter,
so as not to move e.g. the last 1 word of a sentence to a new line.
tt_chunk_min_chars: The minimum number of characters in a single line.

tt_more_accurate:
This option allows you to paste/import a script before transcription.
Keywords are extracted from this script and fed to Whisper (the audio
transcription model), making the transcription more accurate.

This option is highly recommended for strictly technical scripts containing
many words with non-phonetic spellings (e.g., system paths, names with
numbers, special characters, etc.).

Additionally, this option automatically runs the transcript-script comparison
algorithm, so after transcription is complete, colors are immediately
visible, and the Side-by-side view loads instantly.
tt_jump_to_word_info:
Jumps the DaVinci and internal audio player
playhead to the exact moment the clicked
word was spoken.
